title: resourceEnvironment
responsibility: Selects only resource lease, home, worker-budget and priority variables for propagation alongside a separately filtered application environment.

inputs.name: resourceEnvironment.env
inputs.description: Environment record read for the recognized resource and native-worker keys; other entries, including credentials, are not forwarded. Omitting it reads the current process environment.

outputs.name: resourceEnvironment
outputs.description: Only recognized resource and native-worker environment fields, preserving their supplied values.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: A null environment fails at the first property read; no fields are returned.
